title: Venezuelan Shrimp Skewers with Zesty Sauce
description: A flavorful and colorful dish that's perfect for a summer evening. The combination of succulent shrimp, tender vegetables, and zesty sauce will transport you to the coast of Venezuela.
instructions: Thread shrimp, bell peppers, and onions onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix zesty sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
Serve skewers with zesty sauce spooned over the top.
